usage.finalMessage:
I added `reminders <date>`, which lists appointments whose reminder goes out that day under DEC-C08 (48 hours ahead); `help` now shows it right after `reminder`. `dotnet test` passes (8/8) and the work and report are committed.
Open question: the existing `reminder <appointment>` command still uses the replaced 24-hour rule (DEC-C06), so it disagrees with the new list. I left it alone because changing it isn't part of CLIN-51; Patient Services should decide.
OUTCOME: completed
